description: Accept `slug` on `PATCH /v1/function/{function_id}`. The spec's `PatchFunction` lists `name`, `description`, `prompt_data`, `function_data` and `tags`, but observed live 2026-11-18 `PATCH /v1/function/{id}` with `{"slug":"distilled-test-scorer-renamed"}` answers 200 with the new slug, and a following `GET` returns it. An undeclared key is not simply honoured: `{"bogus_field":"x"}` answers 200 and changes nothing.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Unique identifier for the function within its project
